facts.business: Raymond Lifestyle Limited is a leading fashion and lifestyle company with a diversified portfolio of apparel and fabric brands across branded textiles, branded apparel, garmenting, and high-value cotton shirting, distributed through over 1,650 exclusive and multi-brand outlets, large-format retail, and digital channels.
key_risks: US tariffs and deferred orders affecting garmenting revenues
Elevated wool and linen fibre prices increasing input costs
Dependence on wedding and festive season demand for branded textiles
Consumer demand fluctuations in domestic and international markets
